node.title: L1 polarized sparse/full petal-entropy root-pinning ledger
node.statement: For exact petal support sizes a_i, put p=sum_i min(a_i,ell-a_i) and e=max(0,2d+1-sum_i a_i). The aggregate class p+e<=E has size at most 2^M binom(M+E,E)n^(E+1), hence is polynomial at the L1 lower cutoff for every fixed E. This strictly strengthens the old u+e ledger: a singleton petal costs 1 rather than ell-1, while full and untouched petals cost zero but retain a 2^M orientation factor.
